page.layout: Running head at top: "66" left, "NOTÆ." right. Below it, one printed page in two parts. Right of the margin, an upper block of running text continuing from the previous page, then a rule, then a lower block of text with numbered paragraphs. Left margin: upper notes (Arabic, "Ebnul Athir.", "* In sirg.") and lower notes ("* Yamano ... egressus.").

main_text.p: succedentes ] fonar, alluditur, tum quod in alio exemplari à tineis erofo, scriptum fuisse præfixa ﻭ copulæ notâ, conjicimus [والتبا بعة] quod plurale est, [قبع] Dicti autem & alias Tamanensium Reges, [اقبال] & [اقـوال] à singulari [قيل] quasi dictatores à [قـول] quod dictum significat [فينغق ما شا يقول لاد] Ita vocatur Rex (inquit Al Firauzabadus) quia dicat quicquid voluerit, & transit [dictum ejus] seu subditos dicto obsequentes habeat: eandem ob rationem & {*} [مقاول] Makawel ab eodem themate dicuntur. aliis tamen placet (ut & apud ipsum videre est) hos titulos potius regibus minoribus, seu præfectis Regum attributos [القيل ملك من ملوك حمير دون الملك الاعظم] Alkail Rex est è Regibus Hamyar, infra Regem maximum. inquit Allauharius. ita & Abul-Feda [المقاول هم الذين يلون الجهات الكبارمى اليمن] i.e. Al Makawel sunt qui magnis Yamani provinciis præsunt.الملك الشافن السقول والامر Ebnul Athir.
main_text.head: Reges Arabum [الذين كانوا في غير اليمن] i.e. Qui alibi quàm in Yaman regnárunt, ac primò [ملوك الحيرة] Reges Hirenses.
main_text.p: 1 Primus in {*} Hira regnâsse perhibetur [مالك] Malec quidam à Cahlani posteris, ac floruisse tempore [ملوك الطوايف] i.e. Regum Provinciarum seu partium, ita vocant Reges quos Provinciis Persiæ Alexandrum præfecisse autumant.In sirg. مقاولYamano sc. ob' [السعرم] egressus.

page.notes: Arabic transcribed from a faint scan; individual words in Arabic script may be misread and are not marked with [?] throughout. The left-margin notes at the top were read as a stacked group, and the lower margin note ("fc. ob'") is uncertain. "Tamanensium" and "Maleci" are read from print and may differ slightly. The Arabic line near "Ita vocatur Rex" is partly illegible. The asterisk marks are reconstructed from the margin.
